title: "Kasym ushagy carpets" - Azerbaijanian fleecy carpet, Karabakh school, Jabrayi (Cəbrayıl) group
notes: "Kasym ushagy carpets" - Azerbaijanian fleecy carpet, Karabakh school, Jabrayi (Cəbrayıl) group .The name of this carpet is associated with the name "Kasym ushagy", the residents of the villages Shamkend, Erikli, Kurdhaji, Chorman and Shelva, located to the north of Lachin, the present-day district
